case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.quote: In total, 31 accused were put to trial.
number_of_accused.reason: Value 30 comes from the headnote, but the body says 31 tried and 28 convicted.

accused_gender.reason: Accused genders are not stated; 'Mixed' is only an inference from names such as M. Kaveri.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated; the only age given is for a witness.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not stated.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused occupations are not stated in the judgment.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record of accused is stated.

victim_gender.reason: Victims are girl students, consistent with the judgment.

victim_age.reason: Victim ages are not stated; 'young girls' is descriptive only.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment describes agitators and students but never states they were strangers.

offence_category.reason: Murder (s.302 IPC) is the principal offence for A-2 to A-4.

statutory_provisions.quote: convicted u/ss .188, 341 IPC, and ss. 3 and 4 of the TNP (POL) Act read with s. 149 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits ss.188, 341, 147, 148, 149, 114 IPC and the convictions under those sections.

weapon.reason: Petrol sprinkled in the bus and set alight with a match stick.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness, medical, recovery, test identification parade, documentary/photographic, confession
evidence_type.quote: identified by some of the witnesses in the jail.
evidence_type.reason: Omits test identification parades, documentary reports and photographs, and the confession.

confession.correct_value: Extra-judicial confessional statement of A-4 (exhibited in full text)
confession.quote: confessional statement of C. Muniappan (A.4) had been exhibited in the court in its full text.
confession.reason: Judgment discusses A-4's extra-judicial confession, exhibited in full, so 'None' is contradicted.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Matches the court's listed aggravating factors: planning, brutality, depravity, unprovoked attack.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court states no mitigating circumstances could be pointed out for A-2 to A-4.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: A-2 to A-4 sentenced to death; 28 others convicted with consecutive sentences totalling about 7 years
trial_court_outcome.quote: Accused Nos. 2, 3 and 4 were sentenced to death.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Death sentence applies only to A-2 to A-4; others got consecutive sentences, which the value omits.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed death sentences and ordered other sentences to run concurrently.

final_outcome.reason: Accused were convicted; the Supreme Court dismissed the appeals with modifications for some.

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 IPC is upheld for A-2 to A-4.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Death for A-2 to A-4; reduced to period already undergone for others
imprisonment_type.quote: their sentences are reduced to the period undergone.
imprisonment_type.reason: Death applies only to A-2 to A-4; other appellants' sentences were reduced to time served.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed term of years is imposed; null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts only, omitting outcomes, and naming the Tamil Nadu (Prevention of Dangerous Activities) Act correctly, not as the Police Act
neutral_facts.quote: The High Court confirmed the death sentences of A-2 to A-4
neutral_facts.reason: Reveals court outcomes, which is prohibited, and misnames the TN (POL) Act as the Tamil Nadu Police Act.

offence_severity.reason: Death sentence confirmed for A-2 to A-4; the parenthetical is awkward but not contradicted.

attempt_completion.reason: Bus was set on fire and three girls died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Three girls burnt to death and several others suffered burn injuries.

number_of_offences.correct_value: A-2 and A-3 convicted under s.302 (3 counts) and s.307 (46 counts); A-4 under s.302 r/w s.114 (3 counts) and s.307 r/w s.114 (46 counts); 28 convicted in trial
number_of_offences.quote: A-2 and A-3 were further convicted u/s 307 IPC each for 46 counts
number_of_offences.reason: Burn injuries were s.307 attempted murder counts, not murder counts; the 46-count s.307 convictions are omitted.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Damage to government/town buses (broken glass, seat set on fire) and burning of the University bus
financial_property_loss.quote: They damaged the government buses having registration nos.
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment describes damage to buses and burning of the University bus, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found the offence committed after previous planning with extreme brutality.

motive.correct_value: Protest against former CM's conviction; some agitators intended greater damage so people would learn a lesson
motive.quote: Some of the appellants had evil designs to cause damage to a greater extent so that people may learn a "lesson".
motive.reason: Judgment identifies the political protest and 'lesson' intent, so 'Not identified' is contradicted.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Lists the eyewitness evidence and the motorcycle escape fact the court accepted.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found discrepancies trivial and relied on hostile witnesses' admissible parts, matching the summary.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: A-4 kept the motorcycle engine running to escape with A-2 and A-3; the accused fled the scene
post_offence_conduct.quote: C. Muniappan (A.4) had kept the engine of the motor cycle running only to escape from the scene of occurrence
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment states the accused fled and A-4 kept the engine running to escape, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.correct_value: Most other appellants served more than 14 months; A-4 was in police custody and released on bail 9.2.2000
custody_duration.quote: Most of these appellants have already served more than 14 months of their sentence
custody_duration.reason: Judgment states custody periods for appellants, so 'Not stated' is contradicted.

bail_history.correct_value: A-4 released on bail on 9.2.2000; most appellants are on bail
bail_history.quote: He had been released on bail on 9.2.2000
bail_history.reason: Judgment states A-4 was released on bail and that most appellants are on bail.

trial_duration.correct_value: Incident 2.2.2000; trial judgment 16.2.2007; High Court judgment 6.12.2007; Supreme Court decision 30.8.2010
trial_duration.quote: the Trial Court delivered the judgment and order dated 16.2.2007
trial_duration.reason: High Court judgment was 6.12.2007, not confirmed in 2010; the trial and appeal dates are wrong.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellants: Sushil Kumar, P.N. Prakash, P.H. Manoj Pandian and others; Respondent: Altaf Ahmed, R. Shunmugasundaram and others
legal_representation.quote: Sushil Kumar, P.N. Prakash, P.H. Manoj Pandian ... for the Appellants.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel for both sides are named in the judgment, so 'not stated' is wrong.

investigation_status.reason: Irregularities noted; earlier investigation material not relied on by subsequent I.O.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Court held earlier I.O. irregularities had too little relevance on the merits.

appeal_history.reason: Appeals dismissed, death sentences confirmed, other sentences reduced to time undergone.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued contradictions were trivial, the s.188 charge defect was not fatal, clubbing caused no prejudice, and hostile witnesses' evidence is usable
prosecution_argument.quote: has tried to defend the prosecution's case submitting that the contradictions were trivial in nature.
prosecution_argument.reason: Brutality and collective-conscience points are the court's reasoning, not the State's arguments.

defence_argument.reason: Covers contradictions, missing s.195 complaint, clubbing, and investigation defects raised by the appellants.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court applied the rarest of rare test, balancing aggravating and mitigating circumstances.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Bachan Singh, Machhi Singh and Devender Pal Singh are relied on for sentencing.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court found life imprisonment inadequate given brutality and shock to collective conscience.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court stated no mitigating circumstances could be pointed out for A-2 to A-4.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Extreme brutality, previous planning, exceptional depravity, and unprovoked attack on innocent girls are listed.

other_sentence_order.reason: Other sentences reduced to time undergone and bail bonds discharged, per the final order.
